admission.justification: An invented usage total would misprice model comparisons and hide missing capture behind a plausible estimate.

applicability: Source-bound native actor/judge usage recorded by eval adapters and accounting.
conditions: Native session totals and final-call components remain separate.
Actor and judge usage are reported independently.
Missing counters or incomplete native lineage remain unknown.
exclusions: Substituting an estimate or component sum for an unavailable native session total.

evidence: Frozen tree fd6462b85ba9d06f004e323384ea800f9aa5144a, base 59b01fb8f72a38d2d27f9c37b8b9ca2513fd3fa0; path bindings and source hashes in producer-manifest.json; Reviewer R4 and d229-repairs/report.md.

statement: Usage records use native session counters, keep final-call counters separate and do not substitute an estimate for missing session usage.
